subject.title: fix: provider usage accounting, retry/overflow classification, and output clamping

question: Should `Usage.cacheWrite1h` and `AnthropicMessagesCompat.allowEmptySignature` become permanent public plugin SDK contracts with these exact names and semantics?
rationale: The implementation needs the information internally, but regenerating the public SDK baseline commits external plugin authors to these fields; code review cannot decide that API permanence without owner intent.

options.title: Confirm additive contracts
options.body: Keep both optional fields, explicitly confirm their semantics, and add focused exported-surface compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep details internal
options.body: Represent the one-hour bucket and empty-signature policy through provider-internal metadata or helpers without expanding the public plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Confirm additive contracts
recommendation.body: Keep both optional fields, explicitly confirm their semantics, and add focused exported-surface compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider compatibility and shared replay history makes this the strongest available owner for the public contract decision.
